requirements.name: transparent-background

requirements.reason: Visible sky-blue treatment relates directly to the preserved Start SVG's cool-blue cue; measured color happens to equal #70b9ed, but exact equality was not a rejection rule.

requirements.name: geometry
requirements.check: Decode assets/working.png as exactly 64x16: four horizontal 16x16 cells at x=0,16,32,48 with no gutters or added canvas between or around the cells (transparent margin inside a cell is composition, not padding). Consumer basis (unchanged original module src/queue-view.ts lines 4 and 9; identical constants in the proposed successor module lines 8 and 13): running frames 4 (the sheet's cell count, unchanged under either preference), display.cell [16,16] and frameMs 100. Fixture behaviour, descriptive only and scoped to this successor destination as designed: the successor fixture draws only when width == 16*frames and height == 16, slices frame*16,0,16,16 and derives the frame from frameAt() (floor(elapsed/100) mod 4 when animating; the held cell otherwise).

requirements.name: transparent-exterior-measured
requirements.check: MEASURED record (mechanical/local, diagnostic): retain every cell's alpha histogram and exact RGBA component boxes (zero-based, half-open). FLAG for visual review any alpha>0 component touching all four cell edges, or any single alpha>0 component covering more than half of the cell's 256 pixels. The flag is a diagnostic proxy for a canvas matte or grey tile and is NOT a rejection condition (a corner-to-corner X or full-span glyph legitimately touches all four edges with a transparent exterior). RGB values of alpha-0 pixels are not significant. PROPOSAL (seed-rotation construction only): mechanical REJECTION is decidable only under that construction, where each cell's alpha channel must equal that of cw^k(seed) under dst(x,y)=src(y,15-x) (for the current seed 21f5baca...: measured 224 alpha-0 / 32 alpha-255 pixels per cell). Outside that construction the measured record carries no rejection rule.
requirements.reason: Fresh per-cell alpha histograms, exact RGBA boxes and4-connected components retained. Flags are diagnostic only. Working seed-rotation alpha and visibleRGBA equality pass all4cells under the scoped seed-rotation proposal; selective/full alpha remains permitted.

requirements.name: transparent-exterior-visual
requirements.check: VISUAL record (visual/visual; the deciding rule): viewed at 1x and 3x on #172336, the exterior of every frame, including the held cell when stationary shows the panel with no unintended matte, tile, plate, halo or fringe; a deliberate opaque backing shape is acceptable only when it is part of the mark's recorded design and the exterior stays transparent. Partial alpha on mark pixels is permitted; binary alpha is not required. The rejected generated frame whose background held 193 opaque #808080 pixels is the failure class, not the definition of the rule.
requirements.reason: Viewed native and3x colour/gray marks and rendered panel exterior. Negative space remains panel; no unintended solid tile, fringe or halo. Alpha diagnostics were not used as the deciding visual rule.

requirements.name: motion-continuity

All four frames remain in the sheet and in play under normal motion; the reduced-motion hold does not remove or reorder them.
requirements.reason: Inspected actual ordered normal-start and normal-restored exposures, including repeated 3-to-0 wraps at both scales in retained render. Quarter-turn phases preserve one rotating activity motif without a visible end-pose discontinuity. Sampled paint/exposure clocks distinguish actual exposure from synthetic timeline; continuous exact100ms cadence is not claimed.
